note: OFFICIAL statistics-grade run: real LongMemEval-S, n=100 (seed 20260906), winning config (session 4k turn-aligned chunks + 1-turn overlap + decay floor + top-15). Wilson 95% CI [0.394, 0.587]. Honest reading: the stack is STRONG on assistant (14/14) and single-session-user (12/13) questions, WEAK on multi-session (8/26), temporal-reasoning (6/22) and preference (2/8). The n=20 0.700 was an optimistic small sample; at n=100 the CI spans the 0.600 full-context baseline — no claim that the stack beats full-context reading at scale is supported yet. 16 questions re-run after transient Jina rate-limits (resumed block) — all 16 recovered normally, confirming the failures were infrastructure, not retrieval.
